issues: Add a file src/setupTests.ts (can be empty or import '@testing-library/jest-dom') because jest.config.cjs references it in setupFilesAfterEnv, causing a validation error.

wrong_tests.test: Header and Footer shared UI Header contains logo, navigation links and Book a consultation button
wrong_tests.reason: The test uses getByRole('link', { name: /Book a consultation/i }) expecting a single matching element, but the page design includes multiple links with that accessible name (in header, hero, and CTA band). This causes the test to fail with a multiple elements error, contradicting the specification which requires multiple such links.
wrong_tests.fix: Update the test to target the header link specifically, e.g., use within(header).getByRole('link', { name: /Book a consultation/i }) or use getAllByRole and filter by its container.

wrong_tests.test: Home page (/) hero contains two CTA buttons linking to correct routes
wrong_tests.reason: The test searches for a single link named "Book a consultation" on the home page, but the design includes two such links (one in the hero section and another in the CTA band). This results in multiple matches and a test failure.
wrong_tests.fix: Modify the test to scope the query to the hero section only, e.g., within(heroSection).getByRole('link', { name: /Book a consultation/i }), or retrieve all matching links and assert that at least one is in the hero.

feedback: Fix the missing setupTests file to unblock Jest, and adjust the above tests to reflect the intended UI which legitimately contains multiple "Book a consultation" links.
